t: Custom Branding & White Labeling SEO Software
s: This article details the implementation of white labeling for the Pipulate SEO software, enabling custom branding through modified installation scripts and configuration files. It leverages Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) principles for rebranding.
sub: White labeling concept and FOSS applicability
Custom installation script modifications for branding
Nix environment integration for application identity
Runtime branding via `app_name.txt` and figlet display
